targets.descriptor: The neck opening is finished with a narrow self-fabric binding of even width that traces the V and meets in a shallow, softly rounded point sitting a little below the collarbone, so the front reads as an open V rather than a deep plunge. Clearly stitched set-in sleeve seams run over the shoulder points and curve into the armhole, and the sleeve ends stop on the mid-upper arm with a plain narrow turned hem and a faint stitch line, no band standing away from the arm. The body cloth is smooth and continuous with only soft vertical draw lines beside the chest and shallow horizontal creases above the lower edge, and the hem runs level all the way round, hanging straight over the hip and covering the trouser waistband.
